subject: Situational Awareness pitches Fluidstack round that would value the neocloud at $40B
text:
Source: https://news.bloomberglaw.com/private-equity/situational-awareness-pitches-investors-on-fluidstack-fundraise (Bloomberg via Bloomberg Law, 29 Oct 2026)

Readable with source.mjs (opening only): Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness is pitching clients to invest alongside it in a fundraising round "that would value Fluidstack at $40 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter", "roughly double the valuation the startup fetched mere months ago". It says the fund is raising money from its investors "just three months after highly levered bets on artificial intelligence firms nearly led to the hedge fund's implosion".

Keep the hedges: "would value" and "according to a person familiar with the matter". Site Watch says a Fluidstack co-founder disputed the report, but that part is behind the paywall and not readable: leave it out unless a readable source gives it, and don't state the round as agreed.
